nodes.label: card-group Content Block Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon representing the card-group content block. Shows a rectangular container outline with a small text/content preview area on the left (gray horizontal bars simulating text lines) and a blue image/media placeholder on the right featuring a white mountain/landscape silhouette and a small circle (representing a photo thumbnail). Visually communicates a mixed-content card group layout with text and image side by side.

nodes.label: card-group ContentBlock
nodes.description: TYPO3 content block element for rendering a responsive grid of cards with configurable column counts (grid-cols-1 to grid-cols-4). Part of the sitepackage extension. Safelisted Tailwind grid-cols classes support dynamic column configuration.
